title: Tesla reveals new Roadster with space thrusters and promises extreme acceleration and flight capability for 2028
summary: Tesla presents an updated version of the Roadster equipped with SpaceX thrusters, capable of accelerating from 0 to 100 km/h in less than one second and with vertical takeoff, with production scheduled for 2028.

title: Conflict in Ukraine: drone attacks and cybersecurity increase as Russians and Ukrainians accuse each other of espionage and digital aggression
summary: Ukraine attacks Russian data centers with drones and missiles, while Western companies report infiltration attempts by AI agents and hackers linked to China and Russia, triggering global cybersecurity alerts.

title: Nvidia RTX Spark laptops arrive on the market with starting prices of $2,599 and promise improvements in local AI performance
summary: Nvidia's new RTX Spark laptops are now on sale starting at $2,599, positioning themselves as a significant evolution for Windows laptops with a focus on AI capabilities.

title: GTA 6 releases its launch trailer and confirms release date for November 2026
summary: Rockstar presents the first official trailer for GTA 6, announcing its release for November 19, 2026 after years of speculation.

title: ASML faces pressure from lithography equipment demand while negotiating with China to secure its critical supply chain
summary: ASML reports record sales amid the surge in AI spending, while the EU and U.S. seek to reduce their technological dependence and seek agreements with Beijing to save a key supplier from possible disruptions.
